title: CERN Founded
description:
The **European Organization for Nuclear Research** (CERN) was founded on September 29, 1954, near Geneva, Switzerland.

CERN operates the largest particle physics laboratory in the world. In 1989, Tim Berners-Lee invented the World Wide Web at CERN.

In 2012, CERN announced the discovery of the Higgs boson particle using the Large Hadron Collider.
